See also: jabon and jabōn

Spanish

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
jabón
Wikipedia es

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • xabon (obsolete)

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Old Spanish xabon, from Latin sāpōnem, sāpō, borrowed from Proto-Germanic *saipǭ.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /xaˈbon/ [xaˈβ̞õn]
    • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • IPA(key): /ʃaˈbon/ [ʃaˈβ̞õn] (Early Modern Spanish)
  • Rhymes: -on
  • Syllabification: ja‧bón

Noun

[edit]

jabón m (plural jabones)

  1. soap; a bar of soap

[edit]
  • dar jabón
  • dar un jabón
  • enjabonar
  • jabón de Castilla
  • jabón de Marsella
  • jabonar
  • jabonera
  • jabonero
  • jabonoso
  • pompa de jabón
